latin: Quarumcunque uirtutum naturalium uel diuinarum eadem est proprietatis analogia, idem etiam nomen, idem hymnus, idem opus, seruata proportione. Et qui tentauerit exponere uidebit correspondentiam.
translation: For every natural or divine power, the same analogy of properties holds, and with it the same name, the same hymn, the same operation, proportion being kept throughout; anyone who sets out to expound this will discover the correspondence.
